latency_edges: LINK_STAGES+2 from TX sample to RX publication; +1 external producer edge; +1 consumer capture edge
control: one explicit start-aligned phase per endpoint; CONTROL_MASK enumerates every source event/valid bit; all must be zero on slot1
fault_transport: physical beat[B-1] on high beat is spare; sticky wrong-phase fault uses it; receiver masks control bits, reports fault
compiler_cost: N consecutive logical words require 2N-1 launch cycles, versus N at II1; charge N-1 exposed stream cycles plus endpoint latency difference, not blanket +1 per operation
physical_status: MODEL ONLY; no P&R or sign-off claimed
integration: native L74 CONTROL_MASK/source map, per-producer period2 windows, start alignment, plan/relay ownership pending

ne_padding.function: registered low-beat duplicate payload checked at RX
ne_padding.compare_area: 1040 XOR plus balanced reduction OR (11 OR levels)
ne_padding.fault_visibility: same RX complete-word edge; no extra data edges

output_control: each accepted DATA/SIDE event pulses one cycle on completed word; payload holds between words; fault suppresses events
start_contract: one boot-only aligned pulse after wavefront reset release and before first root configuration; repeated start sticky-faults and is ignored for phase; not per-token launch
before_start: payload may be unknown; RX DATA/SIDE event bits are reset0; startup warmup ignores uninitialized channel beats
